source.label: Eternal Central, "GenCon Indy 2010 Vintage Champs Top 8 Decklists" (14 August 2010)

notes.text: Wizards' Gen Con 2010 coverage gives the player count (117), the start on Friday 6 August and the final (Turtenwald def. Bob Maher), but prints only the winner's list.
Eternal Central prints no archetype names; archetypes are the names on the lhc Deckbox sets. Finishes are Eternal Central's; seeds are not known.
Turtenwald and Maher are printed with identical 75s, here and on Deckbox; Wizards printed the same list for Turtenwald.
